subject: Leadership review: targeted retention support and probation decision needed
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Leadership review: targeted retention support and probation decision needed

Team —

Following the engagement pulse and manager check-ins last week I have two related people items that need leadership alignment and HR coordination. I wanted to summarize facts, proposed next steps, and ask for quick decisions so we can act within the coming week.

1) Priya Natarajan — mid-level PM, manager flagged as high engagement risk.
   - Summary: Manager reports increased missed 1:1s, a drop in deliverable quality tied to unclear priorities after org change. No formal performance action currently.
   - Proposal: assign a focused manager support plan (2x weekly 1:1s + 30-day success criteria), plus an outreach check with Talent Partner to confirm personal circumstances.
   - Request: Laura / Naomi — can HR prepare a short manager playbook + a templated outreach note? Attached are manager notes and the pulse row.

2) Rafael Mendes — IC on infra team, currently on 90-day probation after re-org move.
   - Summary: Rafael has partial improvements but several missed deadlines and recurring code quality issues. Manager proposes either an extension of probation for 30 days with a formal PIP or termination.
   - Proposal: I recommend a 30-day extension with a narrowly scoped PIP (sprint-by-sprint checkpoints) and a follow-up calibration on March 23. This preserves retention options while being explicit on expectations.
   - Request: Marcus — please confirm you can operationalize the PIP and collate evidence to support the extension. Naomi — we will need HR to draft the extension letter and confirm legal checklist.

Attachments: priya_mgr_notes.pdf, rafael_pip_plan.docx, engagement_followup_pulse.csv

Timelines: I need decisions by EOD Tuesday 2/24 to meet manager and employee windows.

Thanks —
Hannah Schmitt
VP, Customer Success & People Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: priya_mgr_notes.pdf (PDF)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Feb 2026 11:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Leadership review: targeted retention support and probation decision needed

On Wed, Feb 18, 2026 at 9:12 AM Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Following the engagement pulse and manager check-ins last week I have two related people items...

Thanks for the clear summary, Hannah. I agree with the approach but want to call out a couple of legal/compliance checkpoints before we move:

- For the Priya outreach, keep the tone supportive and avoid language that could be construed as performance discipline. Naomi, can you share the templated outreach and the minimal fields we should capture for confidentiality?
- For Rafael, we need the PIP to include explicit success metrics, timeline, and a documented manager cadence. If the manager wants to extend probation rather than termination, the extension letter must state the review date and next steps.

Action items:
- Naomi: draft the two templates (manager outreach + probation extension) and a short checklist for documentation by Friday 2/21.
- Marcus: please upload Rafael's evidence to the HR folder and confirm readiness for the PIP by Monday 2/23.
- Hannah: schedule a 30-minute calibration slot for the extended review once documents are drafted.

I'll review the attachments later today and flag anything missing.

Laura Bennett
Head of People Ops
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: engagement_followup_pulse.csv (CSV)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Leadership review: targeted retention support and probation decision needed

On Thu, Feb 19, 2026 at 11:07 AM Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks for the clear summary, Hannah. I agree with the approach but want to call out...

Quick update from my side:
- Rafael: I have the sprint logs, code review summaries, and the three missed delivery notes uploaded to the shared HR folder (see link below). I have drafted the PIP skeleton — attached as rafael_pip_plan.docx — that maps two-week checkpoints and clear defect-count targets. I support the 30-day extension.
- Priya: Manager is onboard with the intensified 1:1 cadence and will lead the outreach. We will not involve leadership in the initial outreach unless the employee asks for it.

Questions before we finalize templates:
1) Is there a preference on whether the PIP is labeled "probation extension" vs "performance improvement plan"? The label affects perception; I lean PIP for clarity.
2) For Priya's support plan, can HR provide options for workload reallocation (temporary task reshuffle) so the manager can demonstrate immediate relief?

I can be available for a brief sync on Monday 2/23 2:00–2:30 PM PST.

Marcus Lin
Director, Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: rafael_pip_plan.docx (DOCX)]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Feb 2026 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Leadership review: targeted retention support and probation decision needed

Team —

Thanks — quick confirmation and next steps from HR/legal standpoint:

- Templates: I'll circulate two editable templates by EOD Tuesday (manager outreach note + probation extension letter). Templates will include required legal phrasing and an internal-only checklist of evidence.
- PIP label: Legal prefers the explicit "Performance Improvement Plan" label for the document and a separate probation extension memo if we need to adjust formal employment status. That gives us better auditability.
- Evidence: Marcus, the uploaded artifacts look sufficient for now. I'll review and flag anything missing in the shared folder.
- Privacy & External Parties: We will not involve external HR contacts unless the employee requests counsel. If Acme (related account) wants to be updated on their embedded contact, we will provide a summarized engagement status only with the employee's consent.

Final decision window: Confirmed — proceed with a 30-day PIP for Rafael with explicit checkpoints; proceed with manager-led outreach for Priya and manager support playbook deployment. All documents to be ready for calibration on March 23.

I'll post the templates and the Drive link here when ready: https://drive.redwood.com/docs/engagement-pulse-2026

Naomi Feldman
People & HR Operations
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: priya_mgr_notes.pdf (PDF)]
